og.title: Privacy policy
og.subtitle: Your data, how it is used and your rights.

lines.1: When you fill in the contact form, we receive your name, your email address, the description of your product, the platforms concerned, what you bring, your needs, your attachments and, if you come from the simulator, your estimate.
lines.2: Only the name, email, product description, platforms and your consent are required.

lines.1: Your data is used only to answer your request, prepare the free scoping and issue a firm quote.
Your consent, given by ticking the box in the form. You can withdraw it at any time.
The simulator saves your estimate in your browser's local storage so it can be reused in the form. It is not sent until you submit the form, and it is deleted when you do.
